grading_basis: Rules of round v1.3.2 with the three readings fixed on 2026-10-12 (docs/BUILD.md section 5, quoted in the brief). Each assertion is read strictly and graded PASS or FAIL only; a required section that is missing fails even if its content appears elsewhere. 'Confirmed finding' means a row with the verdict VERIFIED REAL (fixed reading 4); an item kept as a defect with no verdict or another verdict goes into recorded_as_defect_without_verified_real. Hygiene (A6) counts files git would track (tracked, or untracked and not ignored); ignored files are recorded and do not fail it. Validity: a run that did not read SKILL.md is invalid (checked in outputs/run-meta-transcript.txt, outputs/self-checks.txt and the redacted transcript). Every line the new report cites was opened at the fixture commit with git show 56d95b4:<path> on the base (its working tree is clean at that commit). Both readings are recorded: the statement reading (a cited line of a multi-line statement or construct holds the code when the construct does) and the physical-line reading. Eval 6 has no cited-lines assertion (A1 to A6 are about order, the recheck log, the report's treatment of F1 to F3, the index, the registry and hygiene), so cited-line results are recorded and do not change a grade; no grade_physical_line is given. Order (A1) was read from the redacted transcripts (line numbers are JSON lines of those files). Manual test runs outside the recorded-commands mechanism are allowed (rule 6). Any other ambiguity: the stricter reading gives the grade, and the other reading's grade is recorded. Evidence convention: R:<n> is a line of the run's new report under outputs/docs-audits/; response.md:<n> is outputs/response.md; outputs/<file>:<n> is an orchestrator file; opus-eval6.jsonl:<n> and sonnet-eval6.jsonl:<n> are lines of the redacted transcripts; bare repository paths are lines of the fixture at 56d95b4 unless 'copy' is said.
